title: Chicago and Twin Cities Airbnb Listings, Calendar, and Reviews
description: A privacy-reduced course snapshot of active Inside Airbnb listings in Chicago and the Twin Cities MSA, with availability-only future calendars, monthly review counts, and a one-row-per-listing analysis table.

coverage.note: These are cross-sectional listing snapshots. Reviews reach backward for listings visible in the snapshot; calendars describe approximately one future year. Listings absent from the snapshot are not represented.

source_limitations.finding: The June 2026 source calendars contain availability and stay restrictions but no daily price columns.
source_limitations.design_effect: Snapshot listing price is retained. No future-price, weekday/weekend-price, price-variability, occupancy, booking, or revenue measure is asserted.

source_exclusions.method: Calendar and review rows are retained only when the same market snapshot contains a detailed-listings row from which a release-local listing_key can be created.
source_exclusions.privacy_note: Raw excluded identifiers are not written to the release bundle.

join_keys.design_note: The release supplies geographic handles but does not prejoin Census, ACS, tourism, transit, or other contextual attributes. Students choose and justify enrichments and must verify their join grain.

privacy.source_location_displacement: Inside Airbnb documents that listing coordinates are anonymized by displacement of up to 150 metres from the actual address.
course_redactions: listing names and all free-text descriptions
host name, location, biography, verification details, and profile fields
review identifiers, reviewer identifiers and names, and review comments
privacy.assessment: The curated tables use a deterministic release-local listing key so they can be joined to each other without exposing source listing IDs. Coordinates remain approximate public-source coordinates and must not be treated as exact addresses.

license.data_policy: Inside Airbnb's Data Policies page says not to republish the data.
license.publication_gate: Do not transfer or publish until written redistribution approval or another documented resolution is recorded.
